verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a payments platform. Adyen documents only one domain-specific form of it: payout schedules that can be applied to balance accounts, automated managed payouts, and custom settlement and payout times. Nothing shows general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows, and webhooks are event-driven pushes rather than scheduled jobs. Missing for 10: general recurring job/workflow scheduling beyond payouts, schedule management via API or MCP for AI-native users, independent or hands-on corroboration.
